salary_details.details: The selected Guest Players shall be paid a monthly retainership/stipend amount of ₹25,000/-, along with such other financial benefits, if any, as may be admissible under the Bank's extant Sports Policy.

selection_process: 1. Age of Candidate (In Years) [Range: 26+ Yrs (12 Marks), 24+ to 26 Yrs (14 Marks), 22+ to 24 Yrs (16 Marks), 20+ to 22 Yrs (18 Marks), 18 to 20 Yrs (20 Marks)] 20
2. Representation of State / U.T. at National Level [Junior Level: 10, Senior Level: 15] 15
3. Representation of Nation at International Level [Junior Level: 10, Senior Level: 15] 15
5. Field Trials – Sport Specific Skills (Knowledge, Technique & Tactical Understanding) 20

The selection process comprises scrutiny/shortlisting of applications as per eligibility criteria and subsequent Field Trials of eligible applicants. The evaluation criteria carry a grand total of 100 marks.

The minimum qualifying marks will be ‘50’ out of ‘100’ (50%). Merit list of the eligible applicants based on the marks obtained will be prepared in descending order. Final selection will be made based on this merit list up to the number of vacancies.
how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure A) from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely and sign it.
Scan the filled application form along with all requisite documents and certificates.
Compose an email and set the subject line to: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT AS GUEST PLAYER ON RETAINERSHIP BASIS – NEW DELHI CRICKET TEAM”.
Send the email with all attachments to [email protected] on or before 12.10.2026.
important_instructions: Applications received through any mode other than e-mail shall not be accepted. Incomplete applications, applications without requisite supporting documents, and applications received after the last date are liable to be rejected. Candidates shall be required to appear for the Field Trials at their own cost. Applicants must bring a recent passport-size photograph, original certificates/documents for verification, and self-attested copies to the field trials. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature and shall not constitute an employer-employee relationship or right to regular employment. Canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification. The selected Guest Player must remain physically fit to participate in tournaments/events during the retainership period.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket) Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: Minimum 10th Standard Pass from recognized Board. Local Club Level Players who have represented a State / U.T. or the country in National or International competition; or Medal winner in Junior National Championships; or Medal winner in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Medal winner in Khelo India University Games; or Medal winner in School Games Federation of India (SGFI); OR have represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments; OR have represented State / U.T. School Team in National Sports/games for schools conducted by All India School Games Federation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket) recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Bank of Baroda, New Delhi Zone to engage 8 male cricket players on a retainership basis for a period of 12 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket) recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies, comprising 3 Batsmen, 2 Fast Bowlers, and 3 Spinner All Rounders.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket) posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 12.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a minimum 10th Standard from a recognized Board and possess local club level sports qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket) recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 30 years as on the date of the advertisement (07.10.2026).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket)?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket)?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants must submit their filled and signed application form along with scanned copies of documents via email to [email protected] with the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary/retainership amount offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly retainership amount of ₹25,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Bank of Baroda Guest Player (Cricket)?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny/shortlisting of applications based on eligibility criteria and evaluation marks, followed by Field Trials covering physical fitness, sports specific skills, and behavioral attributes.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job in Bank of Baroda?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and contractual on a retainership basis for 12 months and does not confer any right or claim for regular employment.
